Route 1 : QC Hall - Cubao (30 Minutes Interval)
Route 2 : QC Hall - Litex/IBP Road  (30 Minutes Interval)
Route 3: Welcome Rotonda - Aurora Katipunan (1 Hour Interval)
Route 4: QC Hall - Gen. Luis (30 Minutes Interval)
Route 5: QC Hall - Mindanao Ave. via Visayas Ave. (30 Minutes Interval)
